label: GO
call: Go with C, built as the A product: prove the intake agent on your current lawyer, document it in public, and sell only to family, divorce, and criminal firms. $500 for 90 days for his numbers and case study, then $1,500 a month.

why.point: $500 is 5% to 15% of the value if the agent saves one retained client a month.
One niche; every high-ticket vertical needs its own scripts, compliance, and proof.
A 20-firm after-hours audit sells the problem before you have results.
Document, don't claim; LinkedIn is where lawyers pay attention.
One bad call on a criminal line costs the retainer and the only reference.

minority.quote: Losing a quarter of the clock costs less than losing the only reference.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: The first 45 days look good but hide consults that book and don't retain.

next_steps.action: Written sign-off on script, recording disclosure, and case study; launch and log every call.
After-hours audit of 20 firms; 10 documented posts by Nov 2; one free-audit message a day.
Day-30 check, then sign firm two at $1,500 a month.

kill_criteria: Zero extra consults in 30 days: fix the product. Under 1 retained client a month by day 60: rework the offer.
conditions: Lawyer approves script, recording disclosure, case study, and posts in writing before go-live
Baseline from phone records by Nov 3
First lawyer $500 for 90 days, standard price from day 91
Day 30: zero incidents, 1 retained client from the agent, 20 audits sent
Firm two no earlier than Dec 12, set up in under 10 hours
$3,000 setup plus $1,500 a month; guarantee is a setup refund

fights.crux: Sell to other firms now, or wait?
fights.story: Hormozi and Gary V wanted outreach now, Buffett and Naval wanted data first. Both moved: audit now, no price ask before day 30, firm two at day 45.
Hormozi $3,000 plus $1,500; Naval $1,500 only on proof with low setup; Buffett 15% of measured value. $1,500 standard, $1,000 fallback, setup refund guarantee.
Hormozi and Naval argued B at full strength; all four kept it out until 5 paying law firms with 90 days of no churn.

cheapest_test: After-hours calls to 20 local family and criminal firms.
revisit: Day 60 (about Dec 27): retained clients a month, value per client, setup hours, audit-to-call rate.
override_note: Quick mode: Round 3 skipped, spread 1 and no seat at ruin risk likely.
